icone.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a new polished Google Play app icon for the French satirical action/strategy game « Présidentielle 2027 : Le Jeu ». Reference image 1 is a visual style and brand reference only. Create a newly composed SQUARE icon, opaque edge-to-edge background, straight square corners. Hero emblem: huge perfectly legible golden-yellow arcade numerals « 2027 », with bold dark navy outline, white specular highlights and warm orange lower edges; a playful three-point golden crown directly above; small blue-white-red French ribbons at the sides. Background simplified softly illustrated French presidential palace at blue dusk with warm golden windows, minimal confetti. Contemporary hand-painted cartoon game cover, expressive bold shapes, rich cobalt blue, gold, tricolor accents, excellent thumbnail readability. Center all meaningful emblem content within middle 75% of canvas; no elements cropped, no people, no text except « 2027 », no official seals, party logos, ranking claims, badges, watermark, rounded outer corners or outer drop shadow. Image itself should be square 1024 by 1024 or larger.

banniere.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Generate a new finished Google Play feature graphic for « Présidentielle 2027 : Le Jeu ». Reference image 1 is the established game visual style and character reference only, recompose a new VERY WIDE banner with exact aspect ratio 1024:500 (about 2.048:1); full bleed opaque illustration. High quality vivid hand-painted cartoon arcade game key art, cobalt blue dusk sky, French presidential palace glowing warm gold, French tricolor flags, a few tasteful confetti. In the central safe area place a masterfully rendered chunky arcade title EXACTLY « PRÉSIDENTIELLE » on line 1 (singular, accent on É), enormous golden « 2027 » on line 2, then clearly readable white « LE JEU » and smaller white « Jeu parodique ». Title must stay within central 70% width, no text near edges. Golden playful crown above title, dark navy outlines, white-to-blue main title shading matching reference. Around the title at lower left and lower right, three expressive recognizably caricatured game characters from reference: silver-haired man with glasses, black jacket and red scarf left; balding bearded man with glasses adjusting navy tie right; smiling blonde woman in navy jacket further right. Should look playful satirical game illustration, not a political campaign poster. Simplify crowd and decor to prioritize title and faces. Keep all text and main faces clear with generous vertical margins for final exact-size export, no important subject cut off, no extra words, no party banners or logos, no official seal, no rankings, prices, store badges, calls to install, watermark or rounded border. Output a single landscape banner, not mockup.
banniere.retouche: Use case: text-localization. Edit this exact existing Google Play banner. Change ONLY the small white subtitle below « LE JEU » from « Jeu parodique » to EXACTLY « Jeu satirique ». Maintain the same white font style, font size, dark navy backing, centered placement and readability. Preserve absolutely everything else: the title « PRÉSIDENTIELLE 2027 LE JEU », its accents and singular spelling, all characters and faces, colors, crown, flags, palace, confetti, composition, aspect ratio and edges. No additional words or layout changes. Output the same very wide landscape banner.
